proposed.text: A six-storey building installs a dry standpipe with a 100mm diameter riser. How many inlets must the Siamese connection provide at street level?

options.text: One 100mm inlet, matching the riser diameter
Two inlets, as required for a 100mm standpipe

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Sec. 1212 specifies Siamese connection inlet count by riser diameter: 100mm standpipe requires a 2-way Siamese, 125mm requires 3-way, and 150mm requires 4-way.
proposed.explanation: The inlet count scales with standpipe diameter because larger risers demand more simultaneous water supply from fire department pumper trucks. A 100mm riser at 900 L/min can be fed by two 63mm fire hose connections, making the 2-way Siamese the correct choice.
